import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Calculate the number of dogs per district
dogs_per_district = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().reset_index()

# Set up the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a bar plot
sns.barplot(data=dogs_per_district, x='KreisLang', y='AnzHunde', palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Number of Registered Dogs per District in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('District', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Calculate the number of dogs per district
dogs_per_district = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().reset_index()

# Set up the matplotlib figure
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))

# Create a bar plot
sns.barplot(data=dogs_per_district, x='KreisLang', y='AnzHunde', palette='viridis')

# Add labels and title
plt.title('Number of Registered Dogs per District in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('District', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha='right')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
